A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Get to know the idea behind TaskFlow.

What is TaskFlow?

TaskFlow is a fictional productivity product presented as a front-end portfolio project. It explores a calmer way to organize tasks and collaborate.

Can I try it without signing up?

Yes. The interactive workspace above lets you complete sample tasks and watch your progress. No account or personal information is needed.

Is this a real subscription service?

No. Plans and prices are illustrative. There are no purchases, paid subscriptions, or actual customer testimonials on this demo.

Will my tasks be saved?

The sample checklist is for this visit only and resets when you reload the page. This demo does not send your data to a server.
